# `tpm reattest`

@include 'alerts/enterprise-only.mdx'

Renew the TPM-bound client certificate saved in the state directory.

<CodeBlockConfig hideClipboard>

```shell-session
$ vault tpm reattest [flags]

$ vault tpm reattest [-help | -h]
```

</CodeBlockConfig>

## Description

`vault tpm reattest` renews the client certificate that
[`vault tpm attest`](/vault/docs/commands/tpm/attest) saved. The existing
`client.crt` must be present in the state directory, and the command fails
without it. The command reuses the first value of each subject field from that
certificate, so you do not need to provide the `-cert-subject-*` flags again. If
you omit `-role-name`, the command uses the role in the certificate.

<Tip title="Related API endpoints">

  BeginTPMCertificateIssuance - [`POST:/auth/tpm/role/{role_name}/gentpmcert/begin`](/vault/api-docs/auth/tpm#begin-tpm-certificate-issuance)

  FinishTPMCertificateIssuance - [`POST:/auth/tpm/role/{role_name}/gentpmcert/finish`](/vault/api-docs/auth/tpm#finish-tpm-certificate-issuance)

</Tip>

## Examples

Renew the certificate in `/private`:

```shell-session
$ vault tpm reattest -role-name=my-role -tpm-state-dir=/private
Reattestation successful. Certificate valid until: Sat, 16 Jan 2027 17:00:00 UTC
```
